title: Parkio Daily for August 26, 2026
teaser: Oogie Boogie Bash runs tonight at California Adventure; Robin Williams Lost Boy returns to Hollywood Studios; new Mickey ears drop online.

bignews.title: Robin Williams Lost Boy character returns to Hollywood Studios entrance
bignews.body: The Robin Williams character from Back to Neverland has been reinstalled in the Magic of Disney Animation marquee ahead of the attraction's reopening next month. Imagineering restored the classic figure as part of the entrance refresh.

parkioInsight.text: Magic of Disney Animation opens in September. Visiting in the first week typically offers shorter waits before word spreads among guests.

bignews.title: Disney Cruise Line announces fall 2027 and spring 2028 sailings
bignews.body: Disney Wish heads to New York for the first time, while Disney Adventure adds its first port of call. Canadian itineraries return across multiple ships, and bookings open soon for the new schedule.

parkioInsight.text: Fall 2027 cruise reservations tend to fill fast for New York departures. Booking within the first 48 hours of availability usually secures better cabin selection.

bignews.title: Oogie Boogie Bash runs select nights through October 31
bignews.body: The separately ticketed after-hours Halloween party at Disney California Adventure continues tonight with exclusive character meets, trick-or-treating, and entertainment. Tickets remain available for later September dates.

parkioInsight.text: Mid-week Oogie Boogie Bash dates in September often have lighter attendance than weekends. Arriving at the 6pm entry window tends to beat evening crowds to popular treat trails.

bignews.title: Eastern Gateway parking structure breaks ground at Disneyland
bignews.body: Disney held a groundbreaking ceremony for the new Eastern Gateway parking lot expansion. The project addresses long-term parking capacity needs and is currently the largest active construction effort at Disneyland Resort.

parkioInsight.text: Construction staging areas may occasionally impact traffic flow near Harbor Boulevard. Arriving before 9am typically avoids the heaviest congestion around the construction zone.

topstories.title: Six new pairs of Mickey ears launch online at Disney Store
topstories.body: Disney released six new ear hat designs through the online Disney Store. The collection includes varied themes and styles, with shipping available now.

parkioInsight.text: Online-exclusive ears sometimes appear in parks 2–3 weeks after launch. Ordering now may beat in-park availability and higher markups.

topstories.title: Queen of Hearts sour gummies now sold at Magic Kingdom
topstories.body: A new Alice in Wonderland-themed sour candy treat featuring the Queen of Hearts character is available at Magic Kingdom for seven dollars and forty-nine cents. The package uses classic artwork from the animated film.

parkioInsight.text: Character candy tends to sell out fastest at Main Street Confectionery. Stopping in the first hour after park opening usually ensures stock.

topstories.title: Inside Out photo booth arrives at Disney California Adventure
topstories.body: A purple Core Memories-themed photo booth featuring colorful memory spheres from Inside Out is now operating at California Adventure. The experience costs ten dollars per session.

parkioInsight.text: Photo booth lines tend to spike during midday heat. Visiting before 11am or after 5pm often cuts wait times in half.

topstories.title: Little Words Project Mickey collection reaches Disneyland Resort
topstories.body: The Mickey Mouse and Friends bracelet, necklace, and bag charm line from Little Words Project is now in stock at Disneyland shops. The collection was previously only available online.

parkioInsight.text: Jewelry collaborations often move quickly at Disneyland. Shopping at Emporium or World of Disney before noon tends to offer the widest selection.

topstories.title: S'mores treats highlighted across Walt Disney World
topstories.body: Disney Parks Blog spotlighted creative s'mores variations available at multiple Walt Disney World locations. The treats feature twists on the classic graham cracker, chocolate, and marshmallow combination.

parkioInsight.text: Festival booths and quick-service dessert counters tend to run out of specialty items by evening. Ordering s'mores treats before 3pm usually ensures availability.

topstories.title: José animatronic figure from Enchanted Tiki Room on sale at Disneyland
topstories.body: A collectible animatronic replica of José the parrot from Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room is now available for purchase at Disneyland Resort.

parkioInsight.text: High-end collectibles like animatronic figures often have limited inventory. Checking flagship stores early in the day typically improves odds of finding one in stock.

topstories.title: Mickey glass pumpkin figurine and poison apples debut at Disneyland
topstories.body: New blown-glass Halloween collectibles including a Mickey-shaped pumpkin and poison apple designs are now sold at Disneyland Resort. The items join the fall merchandise lineup.

parkioInsight.text: Glass collectibles tend to sell out within days of release at Disneyland. Visiting specialty shops like Crystal Arts before noon often beats the rush.

icymi.title: Storytellers Cafe autumn merchandise arrives at Grand Californian
icymi.body: New fall-themed apparel and accessories inspired by Storytellers Cafe are now sold at Disney's Grand Californian Hotel and Spa, including a Grand Apple Orchard T-shirt.

icymi.title: Halloween merchandise guide published by Disney Parks Blog
icymi.body: Disney released a comprehensive Halloween merchandise guide showcasing frightfully themed products available for guests across parks and online. The collection covers a wide range of characters and styles.

icymi.title: Oaxacan wood carvers shop closing at EPCOT Mexico Pavilion next week
icymi.body: The artisan wood carving location inside the Mexico Pavilion at EPCOT will close permanently next week. The shop has featured traditional Oaxacan crafts for years.

icymi.title: Disney files permit for Bay Lake dock expansion
icymi.body: A new construction permit shows Disney planning to expand a backstage dock on Bay Lake. The project details remain limited, but work is expected to begin soon.

spotlight.title: Halloween characters meet guests at Disneyland through October
spotlight.body: Disneyland's Halloween Time features special character appearances throughout both parks, with villains, seasonal costumes, and Plaza de la Familia celebrants greeting guests daily. The lineup runs through the end of October and includes rare meet opportunities.

parkioInsight.text: Halloween character meets tend to draw longest lines between 11am and 2pm. Arriving at rope drop or visiting after 5pm often cuts wait times by half.
